review.notes: Digits are used for the house number, lane number and phone numbers (they count as known). ने appears three times in the formula "X ने कहा" (the in-place drafts use it next). The plan's "auto driver Deepak" is simply दीपक with a गाड़ी, because ऑटो is not in the palette yet. बाग़ मोहल्ला is an invented locality name made from a known word; the reviewer may prefer a real-sounding one. "के लिए" appears once ("आपके लिए"). sections.title: आप कहाँ रहते हैं? पता और फ़ोन नंबर

sentences.english: Today Sam is at the market.
Deepak is at the market.

sentences.text: वह रोज़ लोगों को घर ले जाते हैं।
sentences.english: Every day he takes people home.
Sam says, "Hello, Deepak bhai."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "नमस्ते, सैम! आप कहाँ जाते हैं?"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Hello, Sam! Where are you going?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं घर जाता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I am going home."

sentences.text: दीपक पूछता है, "आप कहाँ रहते हैं?"
sentences.english: Deepak asks, "Where do you live?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं बाग़ मोहल्ला में रहता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I live in Bagh mohalla."

sentences.text: दीपक पूछता है, "आपका मकान नंबर क्या है?"
sentences.english: Deepak asks, "What is your house number?"
Sam says, "It is house 12, lane 5."
Deepak asks, "Is there a bridge there?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "हाँ, मकान पुल के सामने है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Yes, the house is in front of the bridge."
"The wall of the house is white."
Deepak said, "All right, let's go!"

sentences.text: सैम दीपक के साथ चलता है।
sentences.english: Sam goes along with Deepak.
Deepak and Sam set off.

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "दीपक भाई, आपका मोबाइल नंबर क्या है?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Deepak bhai, what is your mobile number?"
Deepak says, "Mine is 98765 43210."

sentences.text: सैम ने कहा, "धन्यवाद! अब मैं आपको फ़ोन करता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Sam said, "Thank you! Now I will phone you."

sentences.text: दीपक पूछता है, "आप चर्च क्यों जाते हैं?"
sentences.english: Deepak asks, "Why do you go to church?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मुझे प्रार्थना पसंद है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I like prayer."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मेरा गिरजा घर के सामने है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "My church is in front of the house."
"Behind the church there is a lane."
"On Sunday there is a meeting there."
"There are hymns and songs."
"The worship is very good."
"Women and men come."
"Everyone says amen."
"Pastor Anil gives everyone a blessing."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "दीपक भाई, आप क्यों नहीं आते?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Deepak bhai, why don't you come?"

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "मैं रविवार को काम करता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "I work on Sundays."

sentences.text: वह घर के पास आते हैं।
sentences.english: They come near the house.
There is a bridge in front of the house.
There is a garden behind the house.
Aman plays in the lane.
The neighbourhood is very nice.

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "यह मेरा मोहल्ला है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "This is my neighbourhood."
Behind the wall there is a garden.
There is a picture on the wall.

sentences.text: सैम दीपक को पैसा देता है।
sentences.english: Sam gives Deepak the money.

sentences.text: दीपक कहता है, "यह आपके लिए है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "This is for you."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "नहीं, यह आपका पैसा है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "No, this is your money."

sentences.text: सैम घर में रवि सर को फ़ोन करता है।
sentences.english: Sam phones Ravi sir at home.
Ravi sir says, "Hello, Sam!"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "सर, आपका मोबाइल नंबर क्या है?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Sir, what is your mobile number?"
Ravi sir said, "98123 45678."
Sam says, "Thank you, sir."

sentences.text: सैम का मोबाइल मेज़ पर है।
sentences.english: Sam's mobile is on the table.
Aman eats half a banana.

sentences.text: सैम आधा किलो आलू लेता है।
sentences.english: Sam takes half a kilo of potatoes.

sentences.text: वह आधा किलो प्याज़ भी लेता है।
sentences.english: He takes half a kilo of onions too.
Now Sam is at home.
Nani is at home.

sentences.text: नानी बोलती हैं, "सैम, आपका फ़ोन कहाँ है?"
sentences.english: Nani says, "Sam, where is your phone?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "नानी, मेरा फ़ोन मेज़ पर है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Nani, my phone is on the table."
Nani says, "Have some tea, Sam."
Sam says "Hello!" on the phone.

sentences.text: चाचा जी बोलते हैं, "सैम, आप कैसे हैं?"
sentences.english: Chacha ji says, "Sam, how are you?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं ठीक हूँ। आपका घर कैसा है?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I am fine. How is your house?"

sentences.text: चाचा जी बोलते हैं, "मुझे कुछ नहीं चाहिए, घर अच्छा है।"
sentences.english: Chacha ji says, "I need nothing, the house is fine."

sentences.text: चाचा जी बोलते हैं, "आप घर कब आते हैं?"
sentences.english: Chacha ji says, "When do you come home?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं जल्दी आता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I will come soon."

sentences.text: नदी के पास बड़ा खेत है।
sentences.english: There is a big field near the river.
We go to the field.

sentences.text: सैम दफ़्तर में बैग लाता है।
sentences.english: Sam brings a bag to the office.
There is a shop near the office.
There is a road near the shop.
There is a vehicle on the road.
There is water in the shop.
Below the house there is a shop.
